The onboarding checklist screen is complete: `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

- **5 mock steps**, 2 marked `done` (verify email, secure account).
- Each step is an accordion (`<button>` toggling `aria-expanded`) showing a description and a "Start step"/"Review step" button when opened.
- **"Invite your team"** is locked because it `requires` the not-yet-done "Create your first project" step; when opened it shows a note explaining what to complete first, and its action button is disabled.
- Overall progress bar + "2 of 5 steps complete (40%)" text at the top.
- Styling uses `@strata/tokens` CSS variables (with sensible fallbacks) and logical CSS properties (`inline-size`, `padding-inline`, `text-align: start`, etc.) so it adapts across brands, light/dark, density, and RTL locales.

Note: since `node_modules` isn't installed in this workspace, I couldn't inspect the actual `@strata/react` component API, so I built the UI with plain HTML elements styled via CSS Modules + Strata design tokens rather than guessing component names/props that might not compile.
